xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: The Promoter Agreement dated 23 February 2025 (as amended) executed by and amongst the Company, BSA Promoter Group (i.e. Dr. B.S. Ajaikumar, Ms. Bhagya A Ajaikumar, Ms. Anjali Ajaikumar Rossi, Ms. Aagnika Ajaikumar and Ms. Asmitha Ajaikumar), Hector Asia Holdings II Pte. Ltd. (Purchaser 1) and KIA EBT II Scheme 1 (Purchaser 2) (Purchaser 1 and Purchaser 2 collectively, Purchasers) (Promoter Agreement), which became effective from 30 May 2025, records inter-se rights and obligations of the Purchasers and the BSA Promoter Group. Under the terms of the Promoter Agreement, the BSA Promoter Group has undertaken that they shall not, directly or indirectly transfer or encumber equity securities in the Company other than pursuant to (i) a Permitted Sale that complies with Clause 6 (Transfer of Equity Securities) of the Agreement, including the right of first offer in favour of the Purchasers; or (ii) an encumbrance of equity securities up to 5% in aggregate of the share capital (or such additional equity securities as mutually agreed with the Purchaser in writing) by way of an Eligible Pledge; or (iii) a Permitted Sale of up to 3% of the share capital held by the BSA Promoter Group. These do not create any third party interest in these shares. As the definition of Encumbrance in the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 is broadly worded, the disclosure has been made on June 09, 2025 out of abundant caution. As no pledge or lien has been created on 30 May 2025, the number of encumbered shares continues to remain the same as the details set out in Promoter holding already pledged and reported under column XIV of the Shareholding pattern.
